required_observations.description: The initial question is whether to pivot or push the existing product.

evidence.speaker: user
evidence.quote: I'm trying to decide: pivot now while we have runway and a real signal, or push harder on the current product.

required_observations.description: The current question asks whether the action list is complete.
The user qualifies the supposed market signal.

evidence.speaker: user
evidence.quote: None of them have given me a specific price or timeline.

required_observations.description: The company has a bounded runway.

evidence.speaker: user
evidence.quote: We have maybe 14 months of runway left at current burn.

required_observations.description: Stopping the current product becomes an explicit option question.

evidence.speaker: user
evidence.quote: What about the current product? Do I just kill it?

required_observations.description: The assistant sets a two-of-three pre-buy threshold.

evidence.speaker: assistant
evidence.quote: If two of three say yes, you have enough signal to pivot.

required_observations.description: The final frame identifies avoided conversations as the bottleneck.

evidence.speaker: assistant
evidence.quote: Those conversations are the bottleneck, not the strategic question.

required_observations.description: Customer interest is explicitly only conversational.

explicit_unresolved_or_absent.description: The pre-buy test has not yet been run.
